interactions.summary: After Jiang's anti-hierarchy answer trails off, a participant adds a Yale-based interpretation of Peter's weak faith, and Jiang sharpens the irony by saying Peter is exactly the disciple least qualified to test anyone on faith.
Jiang invites the author of a newly written poem to explain its background, and the participant says it was written in a hotel room during Father's Day weekend while being away from family.
The participant reads his poem aloud, mixing English with Malay phrases to speak across distance to his children through Dantean imagery of light, sea, and ascent.
Jiang thanks the reader and asks him to explain what the poem is about.

speaker_notes.note: The poem includes multilingual and halting lines; semantic follow-up should preserve that it is a performed poem, not Jiang exposition.

claims.claim: The participant cites a Yale scholarly reading that Peter's testing of Dante is paradoxical because Peter himself was doubtful and weak in faith.
claims.temporal_scope: External interpretation reported in the 2026-06-20 session.

claims.claim: Jiang says it is ironic that Peter tests Dante on faith because Peter is the gospel figure with the least faith in Jesus.
The participant's poem is rooted in separation from family during Father's Day weekend and tries to tell his children why he is away.
The poem itself presents family love through Dantean images of distance, dark sea, hope, and ascent, treating the children as multiple bearers of a single light.

signature_moments.moment: The examiner of faith is the very disciple least able to pass the test himself.
signature_moments.source_phrase: Peter is the one who has the least faith
signature_moments.why_it_matters: It sharpens Jiang's larger reading of Paradiso as a machine of irony rather than clean hierarchy.

signature_moments.moment: Across the dark sea, the father's poem tries to hold his children not as scattered souls but as one light.
signature_moments.source_phrase: The souls that look scattered ... Not split at all. One light.
signature_moments.why_it_matters: This is the packet's human pressure point and becomes Jiang's bridge from lived love to Dante's Beatrice.

glossary_terms.definition_or_usage: Here it names the contradiction that Peter, a doubtful disciple, becomes the authority who tests another person's faith.

chronology_notes.note: The poem's backstory explicitly anchors this livestream to Father's Day weekend on 2026-06-20, giving the family-separation material immediate lived context inside the seminar.

uncertainty_notes.note: Several poem lines and Malay phrases are ASR-noisy; later public writing should preserve the emotional movement without pretending the wording is fully certain.
